title: Euler's theorem on Eulerian circuits and trails, and Petersen's 2-factor theorem
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the classical characterization of Eulerian graphs and of Petersen's 2-factor theorem, for finite simple graphs. (1) Euler–Hierholzer: a finite connected graph has an Eulerian circuit if and only if every vertex has even degree, and the circuit can start at any prescribed vertex. (2) Eulerian trails: a finite connected graph has an Eulerian trail if and only if it has 0 or 2 vertices of odd degree; when the odd vertices are exactly a and b, there is an Eulerian trail from a to b.
